Requires the Secretary of Defense to operate a Civilian Protection Center of Excellence as the Department's focal point for civilian casualties and other civilian harm from U.S. military operations. The statute assigns it specific functions, from standardized harm reporting to a repository of casualty data and lessons learned.

::: {.official-links}
**Read the law** (official GovInfo text)

[Enacted text: Pub. L. 117-263](https://www.govinfo.gov/link/plaw/117/public/263){.btn-official} [Current U.S. Code: 10 U.S.C. 184](https://www.govinfo.gov/link/uscode/10/184?link-type=html){.btn-official}
:::

## Key provisions

- 10 U.S.C. 184(a): the center is the focal point for civilian harm matters and institutionalizes practices for preventing, mitigating, and responding to harm.
- 10 U.S.C. 184(b)(1), (5): standardized civilian harm reporting and data processes, and a repository of civilian casualty and harm information.
- 10 U.S.C. 184(b)(6): lessons learned from assessments and investigations, built into policy, doctrine, training, and tactics.
- 10 U.S.C. 184(b)(7)-(8): coordination with the combatant commands and the State Department, and engagement with nongovernmental organizations.
- 10 U.S.C. 184(c): a public annual report on the center's activities.

## Why it matters

Enacted as Sec. 1082 of the FY2023 [defense authorization](ndaa-annual.qmd), it wrote into permanent law an institution proposed in the Protection of Civilians in Military Operations Act (H.R. 7625, 117th Congress). Because it sits in Title 10, the Department cannot abolish it administratively, which made the statute the center of the 2025 and 2026 dispute over civilian harm staffing. It carries out the [civilian casualty policy](civcas-policy-2018.qmd).

## Current status

In force. The center was established under the statute. A June 2026 analysis of a Defense Department Inspector General evaluation reported that its staff had fallen from nearly 40 to seven and that senior Defense officials had asked to eliminate it, which would require Congress to change the statute. Check current status.
